parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries an empty 'members' array and all structural_evidence fields (differing_slots, jaccard, shared_ancestor, shared_field_count) are null. There is no grounded evidence of shared fields, methods, or shape between RootTabView and PlaylistView beyond the pipeline's subset-pairs signal firing on their file paths and line numbers. Without concrete member overlap data it is impossible to distinguish a meaningful structural relationship from a coincidental one, so no refactor action can be responsibly recommended.
